title: Quoted Out of Context
headline: QUOTED OUT OF CONTEXT
synopsis: Detective Kit finds the digest's mystery test run was just the words 'bun test' inside a quoted script. Quotes now stay quotes.
altText: A three-panel film noir strip. Panel 1: Kit the fox, in a trench coat, reads a case file stamped TEST RUNS: 3 under a desk lamp. Panel 2: Kit holds a magnifying glass over a script where 'bun test' sits inside quotation marks. Panel 3: Kit leads away Glitch the beetle in tiny handcuffs, protesting.
layout: three panels in a row, rain on the window in the first, a single desk lamp lighting each scene

panels.scene: Kit the fox in a trench coat and fedora reads a case file under a desk lamp, rain streaking the office window

dialogue.speaker: caption
dialogue.text: The digest swore it saw a test run.

panels.scene: Close-up: Kit holds a magnifying glass over a page of script; the words bun test glow yellow, wrapped in quotation marks

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: Nobody ran it. Somebody just said it.

panels.scene: Kit leads Glitch the beetle away in tiny handcuffs under a streetlamp

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.text: I was quoted out of context!
